leadText: Pokémon: Black & White, also know as Pokémon: Black & White Song Video, is a song used as the opening theme for the first dub of Pokémon: Black & White. It is made up of clips from the first few episodes of the season. It replaced the Hindi dub of , (Hindi: बडा या छोटा Big or Small), for rerun television airings on .
plainText:
Pokémon: Black & White, also know as Pokémon: Black & White Song Video, is a song used as the opening theme for the first dub of Pokémon: Black & White. It is made up of clips from the first few episodes of the season. It replaced the Hindi dub of , (Hindi: बडा या छोटा Big or Small), for rerun television airings on .
